access_boundary: This record represents the Veo 3.1 Lite preview release identified by the Gemini API model code veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview, launched March 31, 2026 and listed with an earliest shutdown date of October 22, 2026 and gemini-omni-1.1-flash as its recommended replacement. Google documents that it supports neither 4K output nor extension. The standard and Fast Veo 3.1 previews, the Gemini Omni Flash line, and later video releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a release-specific model page with the model code, supported inputs, output type, and a latest-update month
The changelog and deprecations table give the launch date, an earliest shutdown date, and a named replacement
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release is a preview with a documented earliest shutdown of October 22, 2026, so continued availability depends on Google's lifecycle decisions
